description: On the bed in front of you are a green plate, two slices of toy toast, and several flat sandwich fillings including a tomato slice, green lettuce, a red piece, a pink deli slice, a bacon strip, and an onion ring. The left hand slides one toast slice onto the green plate, then the right hand adds the tomato; the left hand places the lettuce, the right hand stacks on the red piece, and the left hand lays the pink deli slice on top. Next the left hand sets the bacon strip and the right hand places the onion ring, and finally the right hand reaches toward the remaining toast slice to close the sandwich while the left hand rests nearby.
